credits.title: The Girl in the Shadows
credits.overview: A PTSD-ridden country cop is given the lead in a homicide case. Small town prejudices of sexual orientation and gender block her, as a secret she has been struggling with threatens to derail the case, her career, and, ultimately, her existence.

credits.title: The Hanged Girl
credits.overview: A group of friends go on a holiday to St. Joseph's Guesthouse, unaware that it was the site of accused witchcraft and a sacrifice of an innocent girl centuries before. They soon realize that it may be haunted by the spirit of The Hanged Girl.

credits.title: The Hunt
credits.overview: The victims of the Hunt, kidnapped by a dark organisation are forced into sick torture games in an abandoned military base. They face unspeakable horror, unless they can outwit their abductors. The hunt is on: 5 victims, 5 killers, 1 aim... to survive.

credits.title: Ravenswood
credits.overview: When 4 American tourists - Sofia, Carl, Belle and Michael - go on a ghost tour, they get much more than they bargained for, when the ghosts of an evil Doctor and his last patient victim trap them in the old abandoned psychiatric ward.

credits.title: Final Move
credits.overview: To save his daughter's life and restore his reputation, disgraced ex-detective Nick Mathers must catch the sadistic Grand Master killer before time runs out, and the final piece is taken in the deadly game of chess.

credits.title: The 7th Hunt
credits.overview: For Gothic Callie, her deaf sister Ariel, computer nerd Chris, popular Sarah, and misogynist Ricky, their evening plans are about to be re-written. credits.title: The Edge of the World
credits.overview: Three men are reunited after 30 years by the echoes of a terrible crime. Old men now, and at the end of the line they are intrigued to meet a young girl named Sarah. Through her they are plunged back into the sordid (and hilarious) belly of Australia's underworld, both past and present.
